eligibility: Query current PackingSessions.qualifiedPackage and ShippingBatchLabels.packageStatus directly; verify shared resource/package revision, immutable packing confirmation and allocation digest, usable native label and current parcel/resource bindings.
membership: One tenant/store/package belongs to at most one durable manifest; all packages use one carrier account. Membership is sorted, bounded to 32, digested and fixed before source dispatch.
acknowledgment: A manifest receipt never sets pickup, shipped or carrier acceptance. Same source identity and original manifest ID are used to repair uncertain acknowledgment.
acceptance: A source-bound per-package carrier_acceptance event is required for shipped. The same event freezes existing packing allocations. Pickup is separately recorded and does not imply acceptance.
event_identity: Stable source event ID and monotonically increasing per-package sequence; exact replays are idempotent, changed bodies or reused sequences fail.
authority: Current owner/operator with warehouse.receive, action.execute and operation.dispatch for creation; operation.reconcile and event.process for observation; manifest creation shares the outbound label execution stop and recovery egress fence.
privacy: Per-resource membership/event bodies only. Whole membership appears as a digest rather than a shared body that exposes other customers. Existing manifest membership prevents allocation cancellation even when acknowledgment is unknown.
limits: No manifest withdrawal or uncertain-membership cancellation
